body:
After months of teasing, plotting, overthinking, under-sleeping, and yelling at inanimate objects that definitely deserved it, Predictable w/ Stu is soft-launching on Wednesday. You’ll be able to watch it right here on this Substack feed and on 
my YouTube Channel
. I discuss it and preview the new set here:
Your favorite politics-obsessed, market-curious, sports-brained conserva-nerd is back with new content. And we’re kicking it off in the only logical place: the city most responsible for everything we complain about and somehow still re-elect—Washington, D.C.
Subscribe now
Launch week, in plain English (or at least my version of it):
Wednesday, 4/22 — Pseudo-premiere day. We’re recording the first episode from a studio a few blocks from the Capitol. There is something comforting about launching a show about politics, markets, and incentives from the exact place where all three are routinely misunderstood.
We’ll also be in D.C. for meetings—most of which will be behind closed doors, because that’s how important-sounding things work. Topics include prediction markets, the regulatory maze surrounding them, the business outlook, the media ecosystem, and building a network of off-air experts to help us interpret whatever insanity comes next. (More on that later, assuming I understand it myself.)
Thursday, 4/23 — Episode two. Same studio, slightly less confusion. This is a short on-air week by design, mostly because the off-air part is doing a lot of heavy lifting.
Then Vegas.
Friday, 4/24 — I’m heading to Las Vegas for the Prediction Conference at MEET Las Vegas. I’ll be talking about what we’re building with Predictable, but more importantly, I’ll be listening to people who are smarter than me. This is not a high bar, but it is a useful one. If you’re there, come say hello.  And try not to talk down to me.
Share Predictable
The following week, we move into our actual home at Blaze Studios in Dallas.
At that point, it becomes a real show: Monday through Thursday. Markets, politics, culture, elections, the occasional sports tangent, and whatever else looks like it might matter before it actually does.
What you’re signing up for:
A way to use prediction markets to inform reality instead of react to it five minutes too late. The goal isn’t to be right all the time—it’s to be wrong less often than everyone else.
Conversations with people who actually know things—across politics, finance, sports, media, and culture—and are willing to explain them without pretending everything is fine.
Reaction and analysis that assumes you’re smart enough to follow along, but normal enough to appreciate when something is ridiculous.
Me, enjoying this far more than I probably should
You, ideally benefiting from it—financially, intellectually, or at the very least conversationally
First show drops Wednesday. Don’t make me remind you again - just follow along on our social pages to keep up with all things Predictable:
X
TikTok
Instagram
YouTube
Subscribe to Predictable
See you then.
Stu
